zh: 把一个非空真后缀移到前面，相当于把字符串循环移动一个非零位移，所以任何时刻字符串都是src的某个旋转；每一步恰好有n−1种切法，各对应一个不同的非零位移。
设src的n个旋转中有c个等于target。只关心当前旋转是否等于target：从“匹配”出发，有c−1种位移仍到匹配、n−c种到不匹配；从“不匹配”出发，有c种到匹配、n−c−1种到不匹配。
先用O(n²)数出c（两串长度不同直接输出0），初始向量为(src等于target, src不等于target)，用2×2矩阵[[c−1,c],[n−c,n−c−1]]做k次快速幂并对10^9+7取模（负数先取模变成非负），输出匹配状态的方案数。
en: Moving a non-empty proper suffix to the front is a cyclic shift by a nonzero offset, so the string is always some rotation of src; each step has exactly n - 1 cut points, each giving a different nonzero shift.

Let c of the n rotations of src equal target. Only whether the current rotation equals target matters: from a matching state, c - 1 shifts stay matching and n - c lead to mismatching; from a mismatching state, c shifts lead to matching and n - c - 1 stay mismatching.

Count c in O(n^2) (print 0 if the lengths differ), start from the vector (src == target, src != target), raise the 2x2 matrix [[c-1, c], [n-c, n-c-1]] to the k-th power by fast exponentiation modulo 10^9+7 (normalizing negative entries first), and print the number of ways in the matching state.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count the c positions among all n rotation positions that match the target, then use fast exponentiation of a two-state (match/mismatch) matrix.

## Correctness

A matching position has c-1 nonzero shifts leading to matching positions and n-c leading to mismatching ones; a mismatching position has c shifts leading to matching and n-c-1 leading to mismatching. Each cut point corresponds to a unique shift, so aggregating states preserves the number of paths, and fast exponentiation gives exactly k steps.

## Complexity

Time O(n^2+log k), space O(n).
